thread:
Aisha: Heads-up 15 onboarding tenants in this week's cohort are seeing incomplete search results after last night's embeddings deploy. Users report partial index results and slow queries. Need quick external note + tailored outreach for 4 high-touch tenants. cc @Dmitri @Ben :triangular_flag_on_post:

Ben: How many affected total and any immediate data loss? I can pull account list + renewal windows.

Dmitri: Tech recap: deploy at 01:38 UTC introduced a concurrency mismatch in quantized embed workers. Under certain shard distributions pods hit an OOM eviction and some backfill shards were retried slowly. Fix deployed 02:12 to add memory headroom + throttle. Backfill restarted at 02:40. No customer data was deleted; reads are degraded until backfill completes.

Carla: Recommend two-tier comms: quick public status and then personalized notes with credits + optional troubleshooting session for the high-touch accounts. Keep public note short and non-technical.

Aisha: Draft public note (for review):
```
Hi <Customer name>,

We99re writing to let you know we99re currently processing a delayed indexing/backfill affecting search completeness for a subset of new onboarding customers following a deployment overnight. Our team identified the issue and deployed a fix; index rebuilds are in progress and are expected to finish within 40 hours for most customers.

What we99re doing: prioritizing affected backfills, increasing worker concurrency safely, and monitoring end-to-end.
Estimated resolution: 40 hours (we99ll send updates as progress is made).
Compensation: we99re applying a 1-day usage credit to affected accounts; high-touch customers will receive an additional 2-day credit and an offer for a 30-minute troubleshooting/walkthrough session.

Reply if you99d like a dedicated update or to schedule a session.

Thanks,
Aisha, Customer Success
```

Ben: That looks good. I'll attach the tenant list in 10m and flag renewals within 60/90 days.

Dmitri: Sharing a small log excerpt for transparency: 
```
2026-03-21T01:42:12Z kubelet: eviction: memory.available < threshold
pod embed-qworker-5f evicted, shard=17 of 48 restarted
backfill: restarted shards=17/48, eta per-namespace variable
```
After throttling change, restart rate dropped and throughput improved.

OncallBot: Incident INC-2026-APR23 updated  severity = MEDIUM at 4861239910.

Aisha: Outreach plan: send short heads-up to all affected in 25m. For high-touch (listed below) CS drafts personalized notes and offers office hours. Escalate any renewals within 60 days to AE team for proactive outreach.
- high-touch: BrightScholar, Acme Analytics, NovaRetail, GreenMarkets
- rest: 11 tenants get batch note + credit

Carla: I'll draft BrightScholar + Acme messages. @Riley from Sales should we escalate NovaRetail now or wait for Ben's renewal flag?

Riley: If renewal < 60 days escalate. Otherwise CS-led outreach is fine. I can standby for AE brief if needed.

Ben: Uploaded sheet to https://tiny.redwood/incident-4861239876 with renewal flags + owner contacts. BrightScholar shows renewal in 28 days; escalate to Riley. NovaRetail is 120+ days.

Carla: Posting BrightScholar draft now (for review):
"""
Hi Team BrightScholar,

We wanted to let you know about a temporary indexing delay impacting search completeness during your onboarding run. Our engineers have deployed a fix and a backfill is underway; we99re prioritizing your job. We expect completion within 40 hours.

To make this right: we99re applying a 3-day usage credit and offer a 30-minute troubleshooting walkthrough to ensure your search/tuning settings are optimal. Riley from Sales will follow up to coordinate an executive check-in given your upcoming renewal.

Apologies for the disruption  we appreciate your patience.

 Aisha + Carla, Customer Success
"""

Aisha: Nice. For the batch sends, we should include a KB link about indexing/backfill behavior and a short FAQ. Link: https://redwood.help/embeddings/backfill-faq

Dmitri: Backfill progress update: currently 58% across affected namespaces, global rate improving after worker memory bump. No new evictions in last 12 minutes. Will announce 100% when complete.

Carla: Also suggest offering a short config review to any tenant that experienced longer-than-expected backfill so they can avoid shard hotspots in their ingest patterns. I can create a 1-pager.

Aisha: Action items: 
- Ben: confirm sheet + renewal escalations (done)
- Carla: draft 2 more personalized emails (NovaRetail, GreenMarkets) and 1-pager by +45m
- Dmitri: post 100% completion time and final RCA when available
- Aisha: queue batch note and send after 25m review window

Ben: Confirmed I added account owners and renewal windows. BrightScholar flagged for AE call; Riley looped.

OncallBot: Next scheduled incident update in 45 minutes.

Dmitri: Backfill now at 82%. ETA for remaining shards looks ~90-150 minutes depending on concurrency; will post at 100%.

Aisha: Thanks everyone. We'll keep this thread as the single source for live customer communications edits. Will post final RCA and credit receipts after completion.
